data.heading: Come build the marketing company that runs on software it wrote.
data.lede: Small team, real clients, real money moving through accounts we're accountable for. That's the appeal and it's also the warning. Four things we actually select for.

data.heading: Four things we actually select for.

items.title: Teamwork
items.body: Three services, one team, one record. Nobody here gets to optimise their own number at another person's expense. The whole point of the company is that the hand-offs don't leak.

items.title: Initiative
items.body: Nobody will hand you a ticket queue. You'll find the problem, write up what you'd do, and go.

items.title: Discipline
items.body: The software proposes, a named person approves. That only works if the person signing is genuinely careful. Accuracy, follow-through, and saying no to a plausible-looking bad idea.

items.title: Room to grow
items.body: Early team, flat structure, no layer to wait behind. The people who join now define how their function works and then lead it.

data.heading: We'll give you an answer either way.

items.body: Email us one specific thing you built or ran, and what happened to it. A link beats a résumé; a real example beats both.
45 minutes with a person who does the work, not a recruiter.
A paid exercise or a working session on an actual problem. No take-home that takes your weekend.
An answer either way, with a reason. Compensation discussed openly against what you'd own.

data.note: On pay: we'd rather talk about it openly than post a band we'd outgrow in a year. Bring your number to the first call and we'll be straight with you.

data.heading: Tell us about ^one thing you built.^
data.body: Not your whole career, just one specific thing you owned and what happened to it. That tells us more than a résumé does, and it's what we'll want to talk about anyway.
bullets: Links beat attachments: GitHub, a site you run, an account you turned around
No role that fits? Say so in the message and pick 'Something else'
data.footnote: Prefer email with a CV attached? [marketing@golumin.io](mailto:marketing@golumin.io)
